entries.not_relevant_because: Carmichael's question asks whether some value n has exactly one preimage under φ, which is a lower-end multiplicity question. The family proves only the upper-end statement that infinitely many n have more than n^(1-ε) preimages (Erdős's largest-fiber conjecture, Theorem 1 of 'Weighted dilation graphs, smooth shifted primes and totient fibers'). A large fiber at some n says nothing about whether any fiber has size one. None of the three manuscripts mentions Carmichael's totient conjecture, singleton fibers, or minimum fiber size; the matching pass's link through 'multiplicities of Euler's totient values' is a shared topic, not a shared question.
